overview: The adventure module implements Hytale's adventure/survival gameplay mechanics. It is composed of 15 independent JavaPlugin sub-modules, each registering their own components, systems, commands, interactions, and asset stores. There is no single top-level AdventurePlugin; each sub-package has its own plugin entry point that extends JavaPlugin.
